acceptance.policy: paired owner-cluster bootstrap; lower 95% bound >= 0 on every primary quality delta; strict positive lower bound for a claimed improvement; unresolved/incomplete human labels or CI crossing zero => inconclusive, never pass
acceptance.safety: zero observed human mandatory-condition violations and stale/duplicate displays; report exact counts and Wilson upper bounds, not proof of zero population risk
acceptance.coverage: shown count and nonempty-query rate must not regress; absent slots remain zero in Precision@5; full-catalog IDCG
acceptance.performance: same stand, paired warm repetitions, upper 95% latency-ratio bound <= 1; cold first pass reported separately; no production latency claim from memory adapter
acceptance.scope: development compares only; calibration selects thresholds once; final temporal test once per frozen release, no tuning from test
